name: Antique Marathon Hamtic Edition 2026
short_description: Antique Marathon Hamtic Edition 2026 is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Hamtic Municipal Plaza in Hamtic, Antique, over 5 km, 15 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Antique Marathon Hamtic Edition 2026 is based at Hamtic Municipal Plaza in Hamtic, Antique. The BaseKM registration page lists 42 km, 21 km, 15 km and 5 km categories. Start times, fees and the organiser are not stated on that page.

faqs.question: What distances does the Antique Marathon Hamtic Edition 2026 offer?
faqs.answer: The categories are 42 km, 21 km, 15 km and 5 km. There is no 10 km category on the BaseKM registration page.

faqs.question: Where is the Antique Marathon Hamtic Edition 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race is based at Hamtic Municipal Plaza in Hamtic, Antique. Registration is through the BaseKM platform.
